g.text: NeoCam | Companion power, battery sensing and local controls

g.desc: NeoCam | Companion power, battery sensing and local controls

g.text: 2. Battery voltage and charge estimate over I2C

g.desc: 2. Battery voltage and charge estimate over I2C

g.text: VDD and CELL sense protected battery after F1.

g.desc: VDD and CELL sense protected battery after F1.

g.text: No battery-derived analog voltage reaches ESP GPIO.

g.desc: No battery-derived analog voltage reaches ESP GPIO.

g.text: No connection to BAT or USB VBUS.

g.desc: No connection to BAT or USB VBUS.

g.text: SCL/SDA pull-ups use host 3V3, not the battery.

g.desc: SCL/SDA pull-ups use host 3V3, not the battery.

g.text: Fuel-gauge SOC requires matching/validating cell model.

g.desc: Fuel-gauge SOC requires matching/validating cell model.

g.text: Do not set safe-stop thresholds from SOC alone.

g.desc: Do not set safe-stop thresholds from SOC alone.

g.text: Operating target: >=45min standalone image + audio; Wi-Fi/BLE OFF. 720p/30FPS remains a functional target.

g.desc: Operating target: >=45min standalone image + audio; Wi-Fi/BLE OFF. 720p/30FPS remains a functional target.

g.text: Battery/PCM reference is conditional. Runtime, brownout, thermal, charging and safe file finalization are not measured.

g.desc: Battery/PCM reference is conditional. Runtime, brownout, thermal, charging and safe file finalization are not measured.

g.text: USB-C is on U1. Use regulated 5V USB source.

g.desc: USB-C is on U1. Use regulated 5V USB source.

g.text: Active LOW on D1/GPIO2; firmware debounces.

g.desc: Active LOW on D1/GPIO2; firmware debounces.

g.text: Mainboard reference V1.51; expansion reference v1.2.

g.desc: Mainboard reference V1.51; expansion reference v1.2.

g.text: Actual expansion v1.1 equivalence remains to verify.

g.desc: Actual expansion v1.1 equivalence remains to verify.

g.text: D3/GPIO4; GPIO21 reserved for microSD CS.

g.desc: D3/GPIO4; GPIO21 reserved for microSD CS.

g.text: No parallel external charger on BAT pads.

g.desc: No parallel external charger on BAT pads.

g.text: No hard power switch: stop -> flush/sync/close -> sleep.

g.desc: No hard power switch: stop -> flush/sync/close -> sleep.

g.text: F1 supplements PCM; it is not a 1A current limiter.

g.desc: F1 supplements PCM; it is not a 1A current limiter.

g.text: All returns use protected PACK_NEG; never cell B-.

g.desc: All returns use protected PACK_NEG; never cell B-.

g.text: U1 pin IDs denote pad names, not package pin numbers.

g.desc: U1 pin IDs denote pad names, not package pin numbers.

g.text: No U1 footprint or PCB placement is approved.
